name: Generate football tournament match results and brackets
description: Users asked the AI to generate or provide match results and bracket progressions for complete football tournaments, including the World Cup, European Championship, and Beach Soccer competitions. The requests typically involved simulating fictional outcomes or listing specific match scores from the group stage through to the final, often using team flags or predefined strengths to structure the data.
